desc:
⛏️ Welcome to Merge and Mine! 💎

How to Play:

🔨 Merge matching tools to create stronger pickaxes
⬇️ Drop your tools down an endless mine shaft
💥 Smash through blocks and dig deeper
💎 Break ores and discover valuable gems
💰 Earn coins and unlock better tools
⚡ Upgrade your pickaxes to reach new depths
🏆 Discover how deep you can go!

🌎 Can you reach the bottom of the mine?

👍 Like and ⭐ Favourite for more updates!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
